name: FileIcon

props.name: kind
props.description: The kind, when the application already knows it. Skips detection.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Omit for decorative icons (the default) — they are hidden from AT.

props.name: mime
props.description: MIME type. A specific type (`application/pdf`) wins over the extension.

props.name: name
props.description: File name or path. Its extension picks the icon when the MIME type is missing or generic.

props.name: size
props.description: Token size. Omit only when a parent component sizes its icons.

props.name: tint
props.description: Set false to drop the duotone tint for this instance.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.
